skill.name: cultural-review
skill.description: This skill provides comprehensive guidance for reviewing code, features, and content for cultural sensitivity and Indigenous data sovereignty compliance.
skill.summary: Reviews features and content for cultural sensitivity, consent, and Indigenous data sovereignty.
skill.author: Acurioustractor

No prompt injection, data exfiltration, network, filesystem, or command-execution intent was found.

content.value_statement: Sensitive stories can be mishandled when consent, access, and ownership rules are unclear. This skill guides reviews using OCAP, sensitivity levels, and approval workflows.
actual_capabilities: Provides OCAP-based review checks for ownership, control, access, and possession.
Defines standard, medium, high, and sacred sensitivity guidance.
Lists API, UI, and database checklist items for review sessions.
Identifies red flags such as missing consent, broken revocation, and tenant isolation breaches.
Outlines approval workflows for standard through sacred content.
limitations: Does not replace consultation with relevant communities or cultural authorities.
Does not run automated scans or verify implementation behavior.
Does not provide legal advice for privacy or Indigenous governance obligations.
Requires reviewers to map checklist items to their own data model.

use_cases.title: Review Feature Proposals
use_cases.description: Check a planned sharing or embedding feature for consent, ownership, and sensitivity risks before design approval.

use_cases.title: Validate Access Changes
use_cases.description: Review API and database changes for authorization, audit logging, revocation, and tenant isolation requirements.

use_cases.title: Prepare Governance Reviews
use_cases.description: Structure review notes for high or sacred content workflows before community or elder approval.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Feature Brief
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner review of a planned feature.
prompt_templates.prompt: Use this skill to review the feature brief below for ownership, consent, access, and possession risks. Return prioritized findings and missing questions.

prompt_templates.title: Check a Pull Request
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this pull request summary against the API, UI, and database checklists. Focus on consent verification, revocation, and audit trails.

prompt_templates.title: Assess Sacred Content Flow
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced review of restricted content handling.
prompt_templates.prompt: Evaluate this high or sacred content workflow. Identify every point where elder approval, distribution limits, or access controls could fail.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Governance Review Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a cultural review plan for a multi-tenant platform release. Include reviewers, artifacts, acceptance criteria, and unresolved risks.

output_examples.input: A feature lets users embed any approved story on external websites.
output_examples.output: Finding: embedding must check sensitivity level, consent scope, and elder approval. Sacred content should remain platform-only.

output_examples.input: A database migration adds story ownership fields and a soft-delete workflow.
output: Confirm both author and storyteller control rights.
Verify deletion supports anonymization while preserving audit history.
Check that revocation cascades to shared and embedded copies.

output_examples.input: A release plan includes high-sensitivity stories and community membership checks.
output_examples.output: Review result: require elder approval status, access audit trails, and documented community membership verification before release.

best_practices: Verify consent and revocation behavior before approving external distribution.
Treat sacred or restricted content as platform-only unless explicit governance approval exists.
Record unresolved cultural questions as release blockers, not future cleanup.
anti_patterns: Assuming public content can be embedded without sensitivity review.
Replacing community review with generic privacy approval.
Treating ownership fields as metadata instead of enforceable permissions.

faq.question: Can this skill make legal determinations?
faq.answer: No. It supports review preparation, but legal and community governance decisions need qualified reviewers.

faq.question: Does it inspect code automatically?
faq.answer: No. It provides checklists and review prompts for a human or AI-assisted reviewer.

faq.question: Which projects fit this skill?
faq.answer: Projects that store, share, embed, or delete culturally sensitive stories or traditional knowledge.

faq.question: Does it require Indigenous data expertise?
faq.answer: It helps structure the review, but responsible use requires relevant community context and cultural authority.

faq.question: Can teams use it with Claude Code or Codex?
faq.answer: Yes. The prompts can guide Claude, Codex, and Claude Code review workflows.

faq.question: What is the main output?
faq.answer: A prioritized list of consent, access, ownership, revocation, and approval risks.
